verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's left-column stack (eyebrow, headline, body, pill CTA) with the bottle over the peach circle. Its alignment and hierarchy are clean. The only nitpicks are the tight gap between the 'off' headline and the circle edge and slightly cramped bottom spacing. B breaks the reading order. The body copy sits above the headline, squeezed into a narrow 5-line column ('Every / mixed / case of…') jammed against the bottle. The headline is split into '20% / off' and pushed to the bottom-left, 'WEEKEND ONLY' wraps awkwardly, the brand circle is cropped into a small fragment, and the oversized CTA crowds the bottle and the right edge.
